mapper.select: select action_id, case_id, user_id, action_type, scope, start_time, end_time, reason, operator_id, create_time from lf_violation_action where user_id = #{userId} and action_type = #{actionType} and start_time <= sysdate() and (end_time is null or end_time > sysdate()) and (scope = 'ALL' or scope = #{actionType}) order by start_time desc, action_id desc limit 1

select case_id, subject_user_id, source_report_id, violation_type, severity, status, description, evidence, handler_id, resolved_time, create_time, update_time from lf_violation_case where case_id = #{caseId}
select action_id, case_id, user_id, action_type, scope, start_time, end_time, reason, operator_id, create_time from lf_violation_action where action_id = #{actionId}

select action_id, case_id, user_id, action_type, scope, start_time, end_time, reason, operator_id, create_time from lf_violation_action where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc, action_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into lf_violation_case ( subject_user_id, source_report_id, violation_type, severity, status, description, evidence, handler_id, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{subjectUserId}, #{sourceReportId}, #{violationType}, #{severity}, 'OPEN', #{description}, #{evidence}, #{handlerId}, sysdate(), sysdate() )

insert into lf_violation_action ( case_id, user_id, action_type, scope, start_time, end_time, reason, operator_id, create_time ) values ( #{caseId}, #{userId}, #{actionType}, #{scope}, sysdate(), #{endTime}, #{reason}, #{operatorId}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update lf_violation_case set status = #{status}, description = #{description}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, resolved_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where case_id = #{caseId} and status = 'OPEN'
